title: Hot Yoga Studio Directory — Original Hot Yoga Association - OHYA

facts.fact: The Original Hot Yoga Association states that all studios in its Directory meet its standards.
facts.quote: All studios in our Directory meet our standards..

facts.fact: The Original Hot Yoga Association says to look for its OHYA Partner Seal to find OHY classes around the world.
facts.quote: Look for the OHYA Partner Seal to find OHY classes around the world.
